detail.longDescription: On long agent tasks, the usual model cascade runs backwards. Start with the expensive model, then hand off once to the cheap one. AgentBaton (Oct 25): the capable model builds and gets feedback, a cheaper one does the narrower fix-and-verify work. Across 11 model pairs on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and DeepSWE, API cost fell 65.9% on average, accuracy mostly held. Cheap-first handoffs did worse, sometimes at higher cost. https:// arxiv.org/abs/2610.35959 # AI # MachineLearning # AIAgents
